ranged-poke.text: Ranged poke: start Doran's Shield / Second Wind, farm under tower and use Hallowed Mist to deny their autos and targeted spells when they step up.

kite.text: Kiting champion: don't chase through slows; save Skip 'n Slash to close the final gap, not to start the fight.

lane-bully.text: Strong early laner: concede some CS before level 6, trade only when they misuse their main cooldown, and play for mid-game scaling.

true-damage.text: True damage ignores your MR/armor: avoid long all-ins while they have their true-damage tool up.

point-click-cc.text: Targeted CC can't be dodged: Hallowed Mist makes you untargetable from outside — stand in it when they want to lock you down from range.

grievous-wounds.text: They have Grievous Wounds: your passive healing is reduced, so prefer short trades over extended brawls.

burst.text: Burst threat: respect their all-in windows and keep Hallowed Mist for the moment they commit.

tank.text: Tank: your passive shreds high-HP targets — take extended fights, they will lose them later in the game.

early-game.text: Early-game champion: survive the first levels without giving kills; you out-scale.

powerSpikes.note: Grand Challenge: four vitals + healing zone — very strong all-in.
Ravenous Hydra: big healing and wave clear, side-lane threat rises sharply.
Tiamat: stronger short trades and faster waves.

dangerAbilities.name: Riposte
dangerAbilities.note: Parries incoming damage; don't dump Snip Snip! or Needlework into it.

dangerAbilities.name: Duelist's Dance
dangerAbilities.note: Vitals deal true damage and heal her — keep moving so she has to reposition.

dangerAbilities.name: Grand Challenge
dangerAbilities.note: If she procs all vitals she gets a healing zone; disengage or burst her before she finishes.

tips.text: Bait Riposte first (auto/short trade), then commit while it is on cooldown.
Don't fight in the wave early: her Lunge + vital trades win short exchanges before your items.
Fight inside Hallowed Mist so she has to step in to hit you; reposition to rotate her vitals.
Match her side-lane pressure mid game; you scale well into her once you have core items.

itemAdjustments.name: Plated Steelcaps
itemAdjustments.note: Reduces her auto-attack damage in extended trades.

itemAdjustments.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
itemAdjustments.note: Armor + stasis to wait out Grand Challenge burst.

runeAdjustments.note: Helps survive her early trades if you are not confident in the matchup.

Fiora.reviewNotes: Exact Riposte vs Needlework interaction (stun vs slow on parry) not stated on purpose — verify in game.

powerSpikes.note: Strong level 1-3 trades with passive stacks.
Noxian Guillotine true-damage execute; resets on kill.
Five stacks of Hemorrhage (Noxian Might): he wins almost every extended fight in lane.

dangerAbilities.name: Apprehend
dangerAbilities.note: Pull — stay out of its range or dodge it before committing.

dangerAbilities.name: Decimate
dangerAbilities.note: Outer blade heals him; stand inside the ring or out of range.

dangerAbilities.name: Noxian Guillotine
dangerAbilities.note: True damage execute; don't stay in range when low.

tips.text: Avoid extended trades while he has stacks; short trades after he uses E.
Use Skip 'n Slash to dodge Apprehend timing, or stand behind the wave.
Ask for jungle help early — he is immobile and gankable.
Late game you out-duel him with items; don't feed him before that.

itemAdjustments.name: Plated Steelcaps
itemAdjustments.note: Armor against his physical damage in lane.

runeAdjustments.note: Helps against his early burst combos.

powerSpikes.note: Demacian Justice true-damage execute.
Strong first back if he gets early sustain going.

dangerAbilities.name: Decisive Strike
dangerAbilities.note: Silence + speed — cancels your follow-up spells.

dangerAbilities.name: Demacian Justice
dangerAbilities.note: True-damage execute: don't stay low in his range.

dangerAbilities.name: Judgment
dangerAbilities.note: Spin damage; don't stand in it for long.

tips.text: He is a high-HP target for your passive: take longer trades once you have Nashor's Tooth.
Hit him to deny his passive regeneration; short trades keep it off.
Keep Hallowed Mist for his Decisive Strike engage.

powerSpikes.note: Grandmaster-at-Arms: much stronger duels.
Trinity Force / attack-speed items make his extended fights dangerous.

dangerAbilities.name: Counter Strike
dangerAbilities.note: Dodges basic attacks and stuns at the end — back off or step out.

dangerAbilities.name: Leap Strike
dangerAbilities.note: Gap close to you or a ward/minion.

tips.text: Don't auto into Counter Strike; walk out of its range and re-engage after it ends.
Trade with abilities while Counter Strike is on cooldown.
Side-lane duels later are risky — group or match him with jungle help.

Jax.reviewNotes: Unsure how Counter Strike's damage reduction interacts with Gwen's Q; difficulty is a guess.

powerSpikes.note: Hextech Ultimatum locks you in a zone.
Trinity Force spike makes her trades much stronger.

dangerAbilities.name: Hookshot
dangerAbilities.note: Wall dash that stuns — fight away from walls.

dangerAbilities.name: Precision Protocol
dangerAbilities.note: Second Q deals true damage.

dangerAbilities.name: Hextech Ultimatum
dangerAbilities.note: Traps you; plan your Skip 'n Slash before she ults.

tips.text: Stay away from walls so Hookshot can't land.
Hallowed Mist blocks her from targeting you from outside.
Short trades before she has Trinity Force; you scale into teamfights.

powerSpikes.note: World Ender: more healing and damage, revive-like sustain in fights.
Strong lane bully with early sustain.

dangerAbilities.name: The Darkin Blade
dangerAbilities.note: Three casts; sweet spots knock up — dodge the edges.

dangerAbilities.name: Infernal Chains
dangerAbilities.note: Pulls you back if you stay in the zone.

dangerAbilities.name: World Ender
dangerAbilities.note: Huge healing; Grievous Wounds helps a lot.

tips.text: Dodge Q sweet spots with Skip 'n Slash, then trade while Q is on cooldown.
Walk out of Infernal Chains early instead of fighting inside it.
Build Grievous Wounds if he is fed — his healing decides fights.

powerSpikes.note: Full combo with empowered W stun.
Dominus: more HP and fury generation.

dangerAbilities.name: Ruthless Predator
dangerAbilities.note: Point-and-click stun (longer when empowered by fury).

dangerAbilities.name: Slice and Dice
dangerAbilities.note: Two dashes — he can engage and disengage.

tips.text: Track his fury bar: back off when it is high (empowered abilities).
Concede CS early; he wants a fight at levels 3-6.
His power fades mid game — farm safely and out-scale.

powerSpikes.note: The Show Stopper engage.
Grit stored from damage you deal powers his Haymaker.

dangerAbilities.name: Haymaker
dangerAbilities.note: True damage in the center line — step off the center.

dangerAbilities.name: Facebreaker
dangerAbilities.note: Stuns if he grabs units on both sides.

dangerAbilities.name: The Show Stopper
dangerAbilities.note: Grabs you and slams you.

tips.text: Don't dump damage into him and then stay — his Grit converts it into a Haymaker shield.
Dodge the center of Haymaker; side positioning reduces the damage a lot.
Avoid standing between him and minions (Facebreaker stun).

powerSpikes.note: Realm of Death: 1v1 duel where he steals your stats.

dangerAbilities.name: Obliterate
dangerAbilities.note: Big damage on isolated targets — don't stand alone at the tip.

dangerAbilities.name: Death's Grasp
dangerAbilities.note: Pull; dodge it sideways.

dangerAbilities.name: Realm of Death
dangerAbilities.note: Banishes you into a duel; Zhonya's can wait it out.

tips.text: Dodge Death's Grasp sideways; his combo depends on it.
Fight him when his passive is not active (he needs to hit three times).
In Realm of Death, use Hallowed Mist and kite until it ends if you would lose the duel.

itemAdjustments.name: Mercury's Treads
itemAdjustments.note: MR + tenacity against his magic damage.

Mordekaiser.reviewNotes: Phase advantages are a guess; please check against your own experience.

powerSpikes.note: Unstoppable Force: teamfight engage and gank setup.

dangerAbilities.name: Seismic Shard
dangerAbilities.note: Ranged slow poke; Hallowed Mist denies it from outside.

dangerAbilities.name: Unstoppable Force
dangerAbilities.note: AoE knockup engage — don't stand next to your carry in fights.

tips.text: Your magic damage ignores his armor stacking — fight him once you have Nashor's Tooth.
Sit in Hallowed Mist when he wants to Q you from range.
Spread out in teamfights so Unstoppable Force can't hit several of you.

itemAdjustments.name: Mercury's Treads
itemAdjustments.note: MR + tenacity against Seismic Shard and R.

powerSpikes.note: Call of the Forge God: teamfight engage.
Item upgrades for his team from level 13+.

dangerAbilities.name: Bellows Breath
dangerAbilities.note: Applies brittle: his next hard CC deals bonus damage.

dangerAbilities.name: Searing Charge
dangerAbilities.note: Knockup if it hits terrain/pillars near you.

tips.text: He is a tank: your passive is strong into him — take extended trades when his W is down.
Stay away from walls and his pillars to avoid the Searing Charge knockup.
Punish his early trades; tanks scale but you do too.

powerSpikes.note: All Out: kicks a target away and becomes a damage threat.

dangerAbilities.name: Ntofo Strikes
dangerAbilities.note: Third cast pulls/stuns.

dangerAbilities.name: Path Maker
dangerAbilities.note: Charge that knocks back; tough to all-in into.

dangerAbilities.name: All Out
dangerAbilities.note: Kicks you into/through walls and isolates you.

tips.text: Trade after his third Q is used; avoid fighting near walls.
Your % health damage is good into his tank build.
Respect All Out: he trades defense for damage, don't fight it alone.

powerSpikes.note: Blade of the Exile + Wind Slash execute.
First lethality / bruiser item makes her combo burst.

dangerAbilities.name: Ki Burst
dangerAbilities.note: AoE stun around her — don't stand next to her when she's in range.

dangerAbilities.name: Valor
dangerAbilities.note: Shield + dash; trade after it's used.

dangerAbilities.name: Blade of the Exile
dangerAbilities.note: Wind Slash execute in the second cast.

tips.text: Trade when Valor is on cooldown — her shield blocks your snips.
Keep Skip 'n Slash to dodge after Ki Burst range is clear.
She is weaker in long fights than in burst trades.

powerSpikes.note: Vanguard's Edge: marks for Bladesurge resets.
Max passive stacks give big attack speed.

dangerAbilities.name: Flawless Duet
dangerAbilities.note: Stun line between the two blades.

dangerAbilities.name: Bladesurge
dangerAbilities.note: Resets on marked targets and minion kills — she jumps through the wave.

tips.text: Keep the wave near your side so she can't chain Bladesurge on low minions.
Dodge Flawless Duet; trade after it's used.
Avoid fighting when she has full passive stacks.

powerSpikes.note: Noxious Traps zone the map.
Nashor's Tooth makes his auto-attacks much stronger.

dangerAbilities.name: Blinding Dart
dangerAbilities.note: Blind makes your autos miss — use abilities instead.

dangerAbilities.name: Noxious Trap
dangerAbilities.note: Invisible mushrooms; bring sweeper.

tips.text: Start Doran's Shield and farm safely; don't chase him.
Hallowed Mist prevents his autos from outside the mist.
Buy Oracle Lens later to clear mushrooms around your lane.

powerSpikes.note: First lethality item: very strong ranged poke.

dangerAbilities.name: Shock Blast
dangerAbilities.note: Ranged poke, much stronger through Acceleration Gate.

dangerAbilities.name: Thundering Blow
dangerAbilities.note: Melee-form knockback that disengages you.

tips.text: Stand behind minions to block Shock Blast.
Use Hallowed Mist when he swaps to melee to dive you.
Farm safely; he falls off relative to you in long games.

powerSpikes.note: GNAR! teamfight stun into walls (in Mega form).

dangerAbilities.name: Boomerang Throw
dangerAbilities.note: Ranged poke + slow in Mini form.

dangerAbilities.name: GNAR!
dangerAbilities.note: Stun if you are knocked into a wall.

tips.text: Track his rage bar: fight when he's mini and close to you, avoid fighting near Mega transformation.
Stay away from walls when he can turn Mega.
Mini Gnar kites — use Skip 'n Slash to close the final gap, not to start.

powerSpikes.note: Fate Sealed: AoE knockup engage.

dangerAbilities.name: Mortal Steel
dangerAbilities.note: Third Q dashes and knocks up.

dangerAbilities.name: Soul Unbound
dangerAbilities.note: Damage dealt during it is repeated when he returns.

tips.text: Back off when he has the third Q (tornado) ready.
Don't chase his Soul Unbound body; he returns to his starting point.
Mixed damage: build one defensive stat according to his items.

powerSpikes.note: Stormbringer: tower dive tool.

dangerAbilities.name: Thundering Smash
dangerAbilities.note: Charge that stuns — keep distance when he speeds toward you.

dangerAbilities.name: Frenzied Maul
dangerAbilities.note: Second bite heals him.

dangerAbilities.name: Stormbringer
dangerAbilities.note: Disables towers; dives get easier.

tips.text: Avoid early all-ins; he is strongest before your items.
Fight him once you have Nashor's Tooth — his HP scales your passive damage.
Ward your flank; he dives with the jungler after 6.

powerSpikes.note: Stand United: global shield/teleport to an ally.

dangerAbilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
dangerAbilities.note: Blocks basic attacks in the zone — use abilities or step out.

dangerAbilities.name: Shadow Dash
dangerAbilities.note: Taunt dash; dodge it sideways.

tips.text: Push when he ults away — he leaves the lane open.
Wait out Spirit's Refuge before auto-attacking.
Your % health damage is good into his tank items.
